# Mixkit

> > Free stock video clips, music tracks, sound effects, and video templates for creative projects

Mixkit is a comprehensive library of royalty-free creative assets including After Effects templates, Premiere Pro templates, stock footage, and audio resources. The platform features work from artists like Alejandro Magaña, Arulo, Lily J, and Andrew Ev, offering motion graphics, slideshow animations, logo reveals, and specialized sound effects for various creative needs.

## Key Topics

- After Effects templates
- Stock music (royalty-free)
- Sound effects
- Video templates
- Motion graphics
- Free download assets
- Slideshow animations
- Logo reveal templates
- Title animations
- Instagram Stories templates
- Ambient music
- Cartoon & comedy audio
- Monster & magic sound effects
- Premiere Pro templates
